products.name: Xplorer 2 Nuclear Moisture/Density Gauge
products.summary: Nuclear moisture and density gauge for soils, concrete and asphalt pavements, built on a machined aluminum base with a polycarbonate shell. It shows results on a backlit LCD, records GPS position, and exports data over Bluetooth or USB to the i2 MyGauge and Android apps. NukeTrack tracking and a three-year warranty are available.
products.description: The Xplorer 2 measures in-place density and moisture using a cesium-137 density source and an americium-241:beryllium moisture source, in backscatter and direct transmission modes defined by ASTM D6938, D2950, D7013, D7759, C1040 and AASHTO T310. Geotechnical and paving crews use it to verify compaction of subgrade, base course and asphalt lifts. The Xplorer line has been on the market since 2006, and this generation adds a large backlit display that stays readable in sunlight, integrated GPS that tags each test location, Bluetooth links to Android and iOS devices, USB data storage, project memory and software updates by USB drive. The mobile apps save readings automatically, attach site photos, show test locations on a map and email PDF reports. The optional NukeTrack tracker combines GPS and Wi-Fi to locate the gauge, raise geofence and movement alerts and keep a five-year movement history. InstroTek offers a three-year warranty with a first calibration included. As a licensed radioactive device, InstroTek's guidance describes licensing by the NRC or an agreement state in the United States, two independent physical barriers for storage, Type A packaging for transport and radiation safety plus HAZMAT training for users.

products.summary: Lightweight nuclear moisture and density gauge with a backlit 4 x 20 LCD, illuminated keypad, USB data export and Bluetooth reporting through the i2 MyGauge app. Stores ten projects of 40 readings, weighs 13 kg and can be serviced at any qualified calibration facility.
products.description: The MC-3 Elite is InstroTek's simplest current nuclear gauge, from the CPN product line and built for operators who want a short menu and dependable electronics. It determines in-place density with a cesium-137 source and moisture with an americium-241:beryllium source, following ASTM D6938, D2950, D7013, D7759, C1040 and AASHTO T310. The display is a backlit 4 x 20 character LCD that can be read from a standing position, the keypad is illuminated for night work, and density, moisture and related field values are calculated and stored automatically in up to ten projects of 40 readings each. Results move to a computer, printer or USB flash drive, and Bluetooth connects Android and Apple devices running the MyGauge app for maps, photos and PDF reports. A magnetic non-contact depth strip, moisture-resistant surface-mount electronics and a machined base support rugged use. At 13 kg it is the lightest gauge in InstroTek's range. NukeTrack tracking is optional, and the gauge carries a three-year warranty. Users must hold the radioactive materials license and training required in their jurisdiction.

products.name: ThinPave 5500 Overlay Nuclear Density Gauge
products.summary: Nuclear density gauge for thin asphalt and concrete overlays, measuring lifts from 0.5 to 4 inches (12.5 to 100 mm). A smaller base, enclosed source assembly and indexed source rod improve repeatability, and built-in RTK GPS with sub-4-inch accuracy tags each test location.
products.description: Thin overlays are difficult for conventional nuclear gauges because the measured volume extends below the new lift. The ThinPave 5500 is designed by the originators of thin-layer gauge technology to read layers between 0.5 and 4 inches (12.5 to 100 mm), using a cesium-137 source of up to 10 mCi and following ASTM D2950 and AASHTO T355. The base footprint is about 13% smaller than before, which reduces the effect of surface roughness, and the source assembly is fully enclosed so material cannot enter the source cavity and no routine cleaning is required. An index and guide tube hold the rod in a repeatable position for standard counts and field tests. A professional-grade RTK GPS gives positions to better than 10 cm for QC/QA documentation, and results can be read on the display or exported as CSV through USB or the MyGauge app. NukeTrack tracking is optional. The gauge ships in a DOT 7A Type A, Yellow II case with transport index 0.1, and its use is subject to radioactive materials licensing and training in the operator's jurisdiction.

products.name: 503 Elite Hydroprobe Soil Moisture Probe
products.summary: Subsurface neutron probe that measures soil moisture at depth for irrigation scheduling, agronomic research and vadose zone monitoring. A backlit 4 x 20 LCD, SD memory for over 10,000 readings, 32 stored calibrations and USB data export support long field campaigns with a lightweight, water-resistant body.
products.description: The 503 Elite Hydroprobe lowers a neutron source into an access tube and counts the neutrons slowed by hydrogen in soil water, giving moisture content at chosen depths. It meets and exceeds ASTM D5220. The source is up to 50 mCi (1.85 GBq) of americium-241/beryllium in a double-sealed capsule. The instrument reads from 0.0 to 6.0 inches of water per foot of soil, with a stated precision of ±0.024 in/ft at one minute, and counting intervals of 15, 30 or 60 seconds or a user-selected time. A menu-driven interface on a backlit 4 x 20 LCD and a 12-button keypad lets operators label projects and add notes. The internal SD card stores over 10,000 readings and 32 linear calibrations for different tubing and soil conditions, and data transfer is by USB drive or cable. A rechargeable NiMH pack gives hundreds of hours between charges and recharges in about four hours. The gauge weighs 6.35 kg. Typical users are irrigation consultants, agronomists, hydrologists and environmental engineers monitoring moisture or contaminant movement. Neutron sources fall under radioactive materials regulation, so licensing and training requirements apply.

products.name: CoreLok Vacuum Sealing Gravity System
products.summary: Vacuum sealing system that determines bulk specific gravity of compacted asphalt, maximum theoretical specific gravity of loose mix and aggregate gravity and absorption. Samples are sealed in polymer bags and measured by water displacement, avoiding wax, film and operator-dependent saturated surface dry steps.
products.description: Density is the most specified property in pavement construction, and conventional saturated surface dry weighing misjudges open-graded and absorptive mixes because water drains from the sample. CoreLok seals the specimen under vacuum inside a puncture-resistant, water-impermeable polymer bag so its true volume is found by displacement. The same machine measures bulk specific gravity of compacted field cores and laboratory specimens under ASTM D6752 and AASHTO T331, maximum specific gravity (Gmm) of loose mix as an alternative to the Rice test under ASTM D6857, and apparent specific gravity, absorption and bulk gravity of fine and coarse aggregate. A Gmm test takes about seven minutes with little water exposure and no dry-back step. The system needs no empirical calibration, and the readings are independent of the mix or aggregate type. Stated precision is ±0.002 g/cm3 for bulk gravity and ±0.007 g/cm3 for maximum gravity. A 1.25 hp rotary pump pulls the chamber to 1 Torr, and an automatic wire sealing strip closes the bags. GravitySuite and AggSpec PC software calculate and export results. Asphalt plants, contractors, agencies and universities use it.

products.name: CoreDryPRO Rapid Asphalt Drying System
products.summary: Automatic, enclosed vacuum drier that brings wet asphalt cores to constant dry weight in under 15 minutes at near room temperature. A color touchscreen, progress bar, thermoelectric cold trap and an external vacuum port that can also run Rice tests set it apart from the earlier CoreDry.
products.description: Cores taken from a pavement hold water that must be removed before a dry weight can be used in density calculations, and oven drying takes hours and can damage the specimen. CoreDryPRO uses a cycle of vacuum and ambient airflow, an electronic desiccation system and a thermoelectric cold trap that captures extracted moisture and protects the pump, so a core reaches constant mass in under 15 minutes with no heat. It meets ASTM D7227 and AASHTO R79 and is covered by U.S. patents. Cores up to 6 inches (150 mm) in diameter and 7.5 inches (190 mm) tall fit in the chamber. The PRO version adds a 6 x 3.5 inch color touchscreen, a drying progress bar with time to completion, a vacuum level indicator and maintenance prompts. A vacuum pump port with built-in PumpSaver lets the internal pump perform maximum specific gravity (Rice) tests, and an external control plug allows an AutoRice controller to automate that test. Paving crews use rapid dry weights to obtain density results while the paver is still working, and contractors and agencies use the unit to establish matching baselines and core offsets for nuclear and non-nuclear gauges. The standard unit runs on 120 V.

products.name: AutoRice Controller
products.summary: Bench or wall-mounted control unit that automates the maximum specific gravity (Rice) test under AASHTO T209 and ASTM D2041. It starts the vacuum pump, regulates vacuum pressure, times the run, optionally monitors shaker frequency and acceleration, and stores test records that can be downloaded over USB for review.
products.description: The theoretical maximum specific gravity test, widely called the Rice test, underpins mix design, air void calculation and pavement acceptance, yet its repeatability suffers when vacuum level, vacuum time or shaker vibration drift between technicians and laboratories. AutoRice takes over these variables. With one button press it switches on the pump, holds the set vacuum level, times the vacuum period and logs the run. An optional shaker sensor measures vibration frequency and acceleration, parameters that are rarely monitored, so excess agitation that strips fines from samples can be spotted. The controller replaces the digital vacuum gauge in a standard Rice setup, accepts glass flask or metal container setups and holds vacuum to ±0.4 mmHg at 27.5 mmHg. Records include pressure, time, frequency, acceleration, date and project, and download by USB. A menu lets users enter weights to calculate the result. The unit can also automate the saturation step of the AASHTO T283 moisture damage procedure. With a footprint of 12 x 9 x 4 inches and a weight of 5 lb, it fits on a bench or wall, and it pairs with the CoreDryPRO for an automated Rice setup.

products.name: SmarTracker Hamburg Wheel Tracker
products.summary: Loaded wheel tracker for rutting and moisture damage testing of asphalt mixtures under AASHTO T324. A retracting wheel removes lifting of heavy parts, twin water tanks run wet and dry samples at once, and touchscreen controls with HWT-Report software produce multi-test PDF reports.
products.description: The Hamburg wheel tracking test rolls a steel wheel back and forth across submerged asphalt specimens and records rut depth against passes, revealing resistance to permanent deformation and to stripping caused by water. Results feed balanced mix design and help predict field performance in hot climates. The SmarTracker meets AASHTO T324 and the recommendations of NCHRP 20-07 Project 361. Each wheel has its own motor, and an innovative roll-off mechanism retracts the wheel so technicians never lift heavy assemblies. Two independent tanks and a transport mechanism allow wet and dry samples to be tested simultaneously, while a hood, tank design and optional air heaters hold water and air temperatures steady between 20 and 70 °C. A mechanical recirculator keeps water within ±1 °C, and displacement transducers cover 0 to 50 mm with ±0.1 mm accuracy. The wheel load is 705 ±4.5 N at speeds from 30 to 60 passes per minute. Electronics are placed away from the water, the touchscreen runs Windows, and the test stops automatically when a specimen fails. HWT-Report software analyzes multiple tests, calculates stripping inflection point and exports graphs and Excel files. The machine requires 208 to 230 V single-phase power.

products.name: HWT-Pro Hamburg Wheel Tracker Verification Device
products.summary: USB-powered verification tool that sits in a Hamburg wheel tracker tray and checks the AASHTO T324 requirements, covering wheel load, wheel position and speed, motion waveform, displacement readings and bath temperature. HWT-Spec software prepares a compliance report, and a NIST traceability certificate is supplied.
products.description: A wheel tracker only gives trustworthy rutting data if its load, wheel travel and temperature are correct, and these drift with use. The HWT-Pro is a measuring device placed in the sample tray, with centering spacers to suit all major brands of tracker, so contact InstroTek to confirm a specific unit. It measures static and dynamic wheel load, the center point of the wheel track and track length of up to 9 inches. Wheel position is sampled every 10 milliseconds, which lets the software fit the motion to a sine wave and report the deviation as a least-squares RMSE. Rut depth is reported at the wheel contact point, not only through the LVDT readings. A NIST-traceable temperature indicator checks the water bath. Stated accuracy is ±0.2 lb at 158 lb for static load, ±0.05 in for center offset and ±0.3 °C for temperature. The HWT-Spec PC application, which runs on Windows 7 or later, walks the user through verification steps and creates a report showing compliance with AASHTO T324 and the recommendations of NCHRP 20-07 Task 361. The device also provides calibration capability. Laboratories use it before a project starts, after long periods of non-use or when troubleshooting.

products.name: AutoXtract Automatic Asphalt Extraction System
products.summary: Automated solvent extraction and recovery system for determining asphalt content and characterizing reclaimed asphalt pavement under ASTM D8159. Ultrasonic vibration, heating and a closed solvent loop complete a cycle in under 90 minutes, and a 7-inch touchscreen lets the operator program the washing and drying phases.
products.description: Asphalt content and aggregate gradation must be verified in production mix and in reclaimed asphalt pavement (RAP), and conventional bottle-roll or centrifuge extractions are slow and expose staff to solvent vapors. The AutoXtract automates the process under ASTM D8159. A mesh drum holds the sample in a washing chamber, ultrasonic vibration and heat strip the binder, a high-speed centrifuge spins at up to 6000 rpm, and an integrated stainless steel distillation chamber recovers solvent for reuse in a closed loop that prevents fumes from escaping. Users can choose a pre-wash phase and set the number of washing and drying cycles, and a balance port records weights so the asphalt content is calculated automatically and exported as a text file. Sample capacity is 3500 g, filler recovery is up to 300 g, and a complete extraction takes under 90 minutes including drying. Safety locks, an inspection window and an optional connection to a rotary evaporator flask are provided. The unit rolls on four wheels. It is listed as 230 V, 60 Hz, three-phase delta, weighs 240 kg and has a one-year warranty, so buyers on 50 Hz networks should confirm the supply configuration with the manufacturer.

products.name: SmartLoader Universal Load Frame
products.category: Asphalt Cracking and Load Test Frame
products.summary: Electromechanical load frame preprogrammed for balanced mix design tests including IDEAL-CT, IDEAL-RT, I-FIT, SCB, TSR, Marshall and IDT. It operates in load or displacement control, runs on 110 V, and its analysis software compares up to ten tests with coefficient of variation.
products.description: Balanced mix design relies on performance tests that look at cracking and rutting, and servo-hydraulic frames for them are costly. The SmartLoader is a lower-cost electromechanical frame built for these asphalt tests. It ships with programs for IDEAL-CT (ASTM D8225), IDEAL-RT, the Illinois Flexibility Index test (AASHTO TP124 or ASTM D8044), the Louisiana semi-circular bend test, indirect tensile strength and tensile strength ratio, Marshall testing, IDT creep compliance and direct shear on asphalt interlayers, and users can program their own tests. The machine adjusts test parameters, captures results and formats the data automatically, with a color touchscreen for control and real-time load-displacement curves. It can operate in load control or displacement control, and eight analog inputs accept load cells and displacement transducers. The frame holds specimen alignment during a test and the electromechanical drive needs little maintenance. Compression capacity is 50 kN, tension capacity is 25 kN and speed is adjustable from 0.01 to 51 mm/min with 100 mm of ram travel. Removable memory stores thousands of tests, and SmartLoader Analysis Software displays ten tests together, reports coefficient of variation and builds customizable reports. Power is 110/120 V, with 220 V optional.

products.name: MiST 2 Moisture Induced Stress Tester
products.summary: Benchtop chamber that conditions compacted asphalt samples by forcing heated water back and forth through their pores under cyclic pressure, simulating tire action on a wet road. It conditions two 150 mm or three 100 mm specimens in 24 hours under ASTM D7870.
products.description: Moisture damage strips binder from aggregate and is a leading cause of premature pavement failure, yet traditional screening tests can take up to seven days, show poor repeatability and give only partial information. The MiST 2 conditions samples in a pressurized chamber that drives heated water in and out of the pores of the compacted specimen, creating pore pressure and scouring that mimic repeated traffic loading on a wet surface. It meets AASHTO TP 140 and ASTM D7870, and conditioning finishes in about 24 hours with no need to vacuum-saturate specimens first. Temperature and pressure can be varied, with a maximum of 65 °C and 345 kPa (50 psi) apparent pressure. The chamber accepts two 150 mm cores, three 100 mm cores or three IDEAL-CT cores, with sample heights of 25 to 200 mm. After each test it drains automatically to stay dry, and an internal pneumatic pump has stand-by mode and automatic tank refill. The second generation is a quieter benchtop unit about three times lighter than the original, at 74 kg with a 0.76 x 0.61 m footprint. Data can be stored and sent to a PC.
